name: long-context
description: Hand-authored long documents where a specific answer is buried in filler, used to measure whether a compaction technique keeps the answer recoverable while cutting model-visible tokens.
disclaimer: Cases are synthetic and self-authored — not sampled from, or submitted to, any external benchmark. The public benchmarks below are referenced only as task-category analogs so readers can anchor the kind of long-context compression measured here; these numbers are not scores on those benchmarks.

related_benchmarks.name: LongBench v2
related_benchmarks.note: Long-context understanding across single-/multi-doc QA and summarization — the answer-in-a-long-document shape our document cases mirror.

related_benchmarks.name: RULER
related_benchmarks.note: Synthetic long-context stress tests (retrieval, aggregation, tracing) that vary context length while a target fact must survive, like our answer-bearing lines.

related_benchmarks.name: LooGLE / ∞Bench-style long QA
related_benchmarks.note: Long-dependency QA over documents; anchors the single-answer-in-a-long-context task category our cases model.
